newsitem.title: CANADA: H.J. Forest holders approve Jager sale.
newsitem.headline: H.J. Forest holders approve Jager sale.

text.p: H.J. Forest Products Inc said on Friday that its shareholders at a special meeting approved the sale of the company's stake in Jager Strandboard LP to MacMillan Bloedel Ltd.
H.J. Forest said, however, that shareholders did not pass a special resolution proposing a C$2.20 per share distribution from the net proceeds of the sale.
The company said it expected to close the sale on Friday.

Following the closing of the deal, H.J. Forest's management and directors intended "to begin the process of re-defining the future of the company," it said, adding that it would have about C$19 million in cash and no large liabilities.
It said that the Toronto Stock Exchange intended to permit trade in the company's shares while management formulated a new business plan.
